notes:
## New features
- Building names on contour sheets now size themselves to the zoom: small but readable when zoomed out, larger when zoomed in, and never larger than the contour dB labels. A new Map labels → Building names slider sets a custom size (4–40 pt), with an Auto button to return to automatic sizing. The choice is saved per sheet.
- Redesigned Contour Composer action bar: four equal keys (Update, All views, Export, Copy) in two soft pills, with animated icons and hover, press and disabled states. Update and All views share one split key; starting a run grows the half you clicked into a full-width Cancel key, and a tick briefly confirms when a run finishes.

## Changes
- Calculate all views can be cancelled from its own key, and cancelling stops the remaining views from being calculated later.

## Bug fixes
- Building names were drawn at a fixed screen size, so they appeared tiny on contour sheets and exports. They now scale with the sheet.
- Section contours could fail with "Polygonised face has no scalar classification" at fine presentation detail (seen on a section at 16×), leaving the section without contours. A hairline sliver along the section edge is now handled.
- Clicking Calculate all views while a calculation was running appeared to do nothing.
